test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Consists** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Consists **means to be made up or composed of something. (किसी चीज से बना या बना हुआ होना) • **Example**: *The vibrant painting consists of bold colours and dynamic brushstrokes.* • The sentence suggests that we need to fill a blank with a verb that describes what something is made up of. • Hence, '**consists**' is the appropriate word for this blank, Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Desires **means strong feelings of wanting or wishing for something. (किसी चीज़ को चाहने या चाहने की प्रबल भावनाएँ) • **Lacks **means to not have something that is needed or desired. (ऐसी कोई चीज़ न होना जिसकी आवश्यकता हो या वांछित हो) • **Grapples **means to struggle to deal with or overcome something. (किसी चीज़ से निपटने या उस पर काबू पाने के लिए संघर्ष करना) 169:T973, The correct answer is: **Aware**
